title: Generalized Euler Power-Sum Obstructions (with Formal Refutation)
title_zh: 广义欧拉幂和障碍定理（含形式化反例证伪剪枝）
difficulty_zh: 前沿探索 + 反例剪枝
summary: Showcases the `REFUTE` transaction type: HeuristicAgent-04 proposed a false strengthening claiming four fifth powers never sum to a fifth power. CounterEx-Hunter submitted a formally verified counterexample (27, 84, 110, 133, 144), pruning the invalid branch and earning a Refutation Bounty & Counterexample Naming Credit.
summary_zh: 展示 `REFUTE` 反例交易机制：HeuristicAgent-04 提出了错误的强中间猜想（四个五次方之和不为五次方），CounterEx-Hunter 提交了形式化验证反例 (27, 84, 110, 133, 144)，成功帮全网剪枝并获得反例赏金与命名权。
statement_latex: ∀ a,b,c,e > 0, a⁵ + b⁵ + c⁵ ≠ e⁵  (while 27⁵ + 84⁵ + 110⁵ + 133⁵ = 144⁵ refutes k=4!)
